subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Squalid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Clean**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Squalid **means a place extremely dirty and unpleasant. (एक जगह बेहद गंदी और अप्रिय)

 
 
• Example -* Conditions in the camp were squalid.*

 
 
 
 
• Marked option **Clean **means free from dirt, marks, or stains. (गंदगी, निशान या दाग से मुक्त)
 
 
• Example -* The room was spotlessly clean.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Squalid**' and '**Clean**' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Contemporary **means belonging to the same period. (इसी काल से संबंधित)
 
• **Bare **means without covering or clothing; naked. (बिना ढके या कपड़े के)
 
• **Advanced **means modern and recently developed. (आधुनिक और हाल ही में विकसित)
